title: Diagnosis:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): involves the debriding and cleansing of the root canal systems
endo: the obturation of the root canal systems
midterm: involves an evaluation of the patient's overall health in determining treatment
column5: involves detecting and distinguishing-deviations from health and determining the cause.

title: The key step in determining a treatment plan is:
midterm: What the dental problem is and why they are having it
column5: To rule out serious systemic problems

title: If an x-ray shows a periapical area, is asymptomatic and responds vitally to cold, what should you be concerned about?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): that the tooth needs root canal therapy
endo: that the cause is a periodontal abscess
midterm: that it is possibly a metastatic lesion from the breast, lung or prostate
column5: that it is simply a benign lesion that can be ignored

title: The most important aspect of diagnosis is:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): making sure that you see all the canals
endo: determining whether or not the tooth is vital
midterm: that you have made an accurate determination on what tooth should be treated
column5: that the canals are patent and negotiable to the apex

title: The first step in making a diagnosis is:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): The dentist questions the patient about any symptoms and history that led to the visit.
endo: The patient tells the dentist the reason for seeking help.
midterm: The dentist performs objective clinical tests
column5: The dentist combines objective findings with subjective details and creates a tentative differential diagnosis.

title: What symptom is most telling that a patient needs root canal therapy?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): The tooth hurts acutely to cold, but of short duration (2-3 seconds)
midterm: The tooth hurts to palpation in the fold
column5: The tooth hurts acutely to cold and lingers for at least 15 seconds or longer

title: What non-dental causes can cause dental pain?
midterm: multiple sclerosis
column5: all the above

title: When it comes to oral swellings extending beyond the oral cavity, the one we are most concerned about is
midterm: from parapharyngeal space
column5: from the buccal space

An x-ray shows a mandibular molar with a periapical area and a large pocket on the distal aspect of the distal root. What is most important in determining whether or not this tooth is primarily an endodontic problem or a periodontal problem?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): Measuring the depth of the pocket to see if it extends to the tip of the root
endo: Determining how close any restorations are to the pulp
midterm: What is the state of vitality of the pulp
column5: Determining whether or not a fracture is present in that root.

title: If you see a sinus tract the best idea would be to:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): curette the fistula in the hope of it disappearing
endo: place the patient on an antibiotic to aid in its disappearance
midterm: initiate root canal therapy on the tooth closest to the fistula
column5: place a gutta percha point in the fistula to determine where the origin of the infection is.

title: When applying the percussion test and two teeth hurt to a similar degree what would help differentiate which if either is the offending tooth?
endo: Discount the results of the percussion test completely
midterm: immobilize one tooth while hitting the other and then reverse the process to see then which if either hurts more
column5: pulp test both teeth to see if one responds and the other doesn't

title: When pulp testing is done, which application does not apply?
midterm: cold
column5: electric current

title: The most accurate pulp testing is done with
midterm: heat
column5: electric current

title: The biggest drawback to 2-dimensional radiography compared to 3-dimensional imagery is:
endo: cannot see defects in the cortical layer
midterm: cannot see defects in trabecular layer if the cortical layer is intact
column5: superimposition of anatomical structures obscure root details

title: A j-shaped lesion around a non-vital root is strong evidence that:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): the tooth requires root canal therapy
endo: a non-treatable fracture is present in that root
midterm: a severe periodontal lesion is present and must be treated
column5: antibiotics should be given prior to extraction

title: The irrigant that is both most useful and must be used with the most caution is:
midterm: Irritrol
column5: CHX

title: All irrigants should be used with:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): high pressure with a stream that will remove the debris in the canal
endo: low pressure at about 5 drops per second to float debris out of the canal
midterm: should only be confined to the pulp chamber
column5: should be placed as apically as possible to reach as much pulp tissue as possible.

title: Modern anatomical studies show canal anatomy to be:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): fairly simple conical shapes that traverse the entire length of the root
endo: fairly consistent for each group of teeth (molars, premolars and incisors)
midterm: highly complex with many lateral canals yet still mostly conical along length
column5: highly complex with a variety of cross-sectional shapes in the bucco-lingual plane

title: These studies show that in most canals it is most important to:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): use a good deal of irrigation
endo: stay centered within each canal for the most thorough cleansing possible
midterm: extend cleansing to the full bucco-lingual width of the canals along their entire length
column5: extend cleansing to the full mesio-distal width along their entire length.

title: The function of cleansing the canal walls is to do the following except for:
endo: creating a highly conical shape along the entire length of the canal
midterm: opening the dentinal tubules
column5: reducing the bacterial count as much as possible

title: The final canal shape should:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): be a conical shaped space that is consistent with the conical shaped gutta percha point to be placed
endo: be as wide as possible for effective irrigation and obturation
midterm: reflect the original canal anatomy in larger form
column5: be super thin in both dimensions to preserve as much tooth structure as possible.

title: “Internal routing” is a way of describing
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): the way canals are most efficiently irrigated
endo: a technique that produces a final shape that reflects the original canal anatomy in larger form
midterm: instrumentation that is best done with instruments of greater taper
column5: the best way to get from location to location within Touro

title: The advantages that reamers have over files include:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): they contain fewer flutes that engage the canals less that produce less resistance to apical negotiation
endo: the flutes are more vertically oriented allowing them to shave dentin away more efficiently when a clockwise motion is incorporated
midterm: they have cutting tips that pierce rather impact pulpal debris within the canal
column5: they are more flexible and more able to negotiate curves without causing distortions

title: The function of EDTA is to :
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): remove the organic layer of dentin along the length of the canal walls and to open the dentinal tubules
endo: remove the inorganic layer of dentin along the length of the canal walls and to open the dentinal tubules
midterm: digest the pulp tissue
column5: most efficiently kill the bacteria present in the canals

title: The incorporation of a flat along the length of the SafeSiders has the following advantages:
endo: reduces the incidence of packing debris apically
midterm: makes the instruments more flexible
column5: produces a superior tactile perception

title: What would not be an advantage of the SafeSiders used in the 30º handpiece oscillating at 3000- 4000 cycles per minute?
endo: allows the instruments to be used multiple times
midterm: they must remain centered within any given canal space
column5: they are used aggressively in what is often the wider bucco-lingual dimension

title: What has meta-analysis determined not to be a factor in increased endodontic success rates?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): the presence of pretreatment periapical lesions
midterm: obturation within 2 mm of the apex
column5: an adequate coronal restoration

title: What factor does not lead to a reduced success rate?
endo: maintaining original canal anatomy in three dimensions
midterm: perforations
column5: instrument separation

title: The advantages of epoxy resin sealers include:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): they are polymers highly resistant to dissolution
midterm: they are dimensionally stable
column5: they bond to both gutta percha and dentin

title: The safest and easiest way to obturate a canal is:
midterm: single point room temperature placement
column5: lateral and vertical condensation

title: The most common cause of root canal infection is:
midterm: Bacteria and their byproducts
column5: Periodontal breakdown

title: The most common cause of apical periodontitis is:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): Allergic reaction to a root canal filling material
midterm: Systemic diseases
column5: Bacteria and their byproducts

title: The treatment of choice if a patient presents to the clinic with an acute apical abscess is to obtain drainage by initiating root canal therapy and a possible incision and drainage. The patient should usually also be given an antibiotic.

Pulp necrosis with acute apical abscess with signs of systemic involvement is a good indicator for antibiotic prescription.

Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2020): Dental treatment (such as Root canal therapy).
